text:
sam: Quick flag  model burn for tenant=nebula spiked during a variant rollout. Warmup tokens showing up in per-model totals (~95k). Anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:
maria: Yep. Telemetry marks `is_warmup` but our dashboard aggregates by `total_tokens` so it inflates the model row.
chet: UX ask  add a heatmap switch to exclude warmup and show "Estimated warmup" in rollout preview. PMs keep getting surprised.
ops-bot: Created RW-5120: separate warmup metric + UI toggle (unassigned).
maria: Backend plan: emit `model_tokens_warmup` and `model_tokens_user` rollups, add API param `include_warmup=false` for console endpoints. Also add `warmup_pct` per-variant for rollout preview.
chet: Copy suggestion: "Warmup tokens are system-initiated prefetches and probes. Billable; shown separately to avoid skewing model comparisons." Short + long ready.
sam: Nice. Can we also show the warmup contribution in the sparkline hover? Helps PMs.
maria: Will add `model_cost_excluding_warmup` timeseries. ETA backend change: next Wednesday.
chet: I'll add the mock and the rollout preview with the estimated $ amount.
sam: Thanks 44D tagging RW-5120 for follow-ups.
